title: What is money?
goal: Learn that money is a tool we swap for things we need.

slides.text: Money is what we use to buy things. You can swap it for food, toys or a ride.
slides.title: Money is a tool

slides.text: People earn money when they do a job. A job is work you do for pay.
slides.title: People earn money

slides.text: A price is how much money a thing costs. A toy might have a price of $5.
slides.title: Prices

slides.text: You can spend money now, or save it for later. Saving means you keep it.
slides.title: Spend or save
